mapper.sql: select id, category_id, source_id, caption, post_date, media_count, photo_count, video_count, views, sort_order, status, is_top, created_at, updated_at from tg_posts
mapper.select:
select count(*) from tg_posts where category_id = #{categoryId} and status = 1
and caption like concat('%', #{caption}, '%')

select id, post_id, media_type, local_path, local_url, width, height, file_size, mime_type, duration, supports_streaming, thumb_url, thumb_width, thumb_height, first_frame_url, sort_order, is_recommend, created_at from tg_media where post_id = #{postId} order by sort_order asc
mapper.update: update tg_posts set views = views + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tg_posts p inner join categories c on c.id = p.category_id where p.status = 1 and c.status = 1 and c.is_telegram = 1

select p.id, p.category_id, p.caption, p.post_date, p.media_count, p.photo_count, p.video_count, p.status, p.updated_at from tg_posts p inner join categories c on c.id = p.category_id where p.status = 1 and c.status = 1 and c.is_telegram = 1 order by p.id asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select id, name, description, sort_order, status, is_telegram, updated_at from categories where status = 1 and is_telegram = 1 order by sort_order desc, id desc
mapper.update: update tg_media set is_recommend = #{isRecommend} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from tg_posts where id in #{id}
delete from tg_media where post_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select id from tg_posts where source_id = #{sourceId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into tg_posts ( category_id, source_id, caption, post_date, media_count, photo_count, video_count, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{categoryId}, #{sourceId}, #{caption}, #{postDate}, #{mediaCount}, #{photoCount}, #{videoCount}, #{sortOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW(), NOW() )

insert into tg_media ( post_id, media_type, local_path, local_url, width, height, file_size, mime_type, duration, supports_streaming, thumb_url, thumb_width, thumb_height, first_frame_url, sort_order, created_at ) values
( #{m.postId}, #{m.mediaType}, #{m.localPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m.localUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m.width, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{m.height, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{m.fileSize, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{m.mimeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m.duration, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{m.supportsStreaming, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{m.thumbUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m.thumbWidth, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{m.thumbHeight, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{m.firstFrameUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m.sortOrder}, NOW() )
